value.rationale: The problem is a natural sparse-spectral restriction of the classical Poisson semigroup. Beyond the known contraction threshold it exhibits an exact additional cutoff at which a third mode becomes necessary, and the cutoff varies with the frequency gap. The only additive fourth-moment collision n=2m removes the higher-mode-free phase entirely and changes the onset coefficient by a sharp factor 3/2. This classifies optimizer support and supplies useful structural information not reducible to a generic contractivity estimate.
